headline_seed: Why are Houthi missiles breaking through Saudi Arabia’s air defences? - Al Jazeera
draft_text:
A Houthi missile strike on Riyadh's King Khalid airport Saturday killed at least 12, including one American, and wounded roughly 300. Al Jazeera and CBS News report it was the deadliest attack on Saudi soil in more than a decade.

And that's the mews.
